browser: Chromium (Playwright, headless), phone viewport 390x844, same machine as the server, loopback network, fake Breeze

libraryDom.note: every tile is in the DOM (no virtualisation or paging)

library.firstTile.fromNavigation.what: Library: navigation to the first book tile on screen

library.firstTile.afterData.what: Library: first book tile on screen, counted from the first book list response arriving

library.allTiles.afterLastData.what: Library: all tiles rendered, counted from the last book list response arriving (spec: opens in under 1 s after data arrives)

library.allTiles.fromNavigation.what: Library: navigation to all tiles rendered

library.firstContentfulPaint.what: Library: first contentful paint from navigation

home.firstTile.fromNavigation.what: Home: navigation to the first book tile on screen

home.firstTile.afterData.what: Home: first tile on screen, counted from the last book list response arriving (spec: under 1 s after data arrives)

library.scroll.longTasks.what: Library: long tasks (over 50 ms) during a programmatic scroll through all tiles in 2.5 s

library.scroll.maxLongTask.what: Library: the longest task during that scroll

library.scroll.slowFrames.what: Library: frames over 50 ms during that scroll (headless, software rendering)

library.scroll.maxFrame.what: Library: the longest frame during that scroll

library.memory.jsHeapMB.what: Library (501 tiles): JS heap in use after a garbage collection

library.search.keypressToResults.what: Library: last keypress of "vol4" to the matching tiles on screen (includes the 250 ms typing pause)
library.search.keypressToResults.note: the server answers q= in a few ms; the UI waits 250 ms after the last key; 111 matches

book.search.zebracorn.what: In-book search for "zebracorn": last keypress to results on screen (includes the typing pause)

book.search.worst.what: In-book search, either word: last keypress to results on screen (spec: within 500 ms)

book.search.lantern.what: In-book search for "lantern": last keypress to results on screen (includes the typing pause)

resume.toReady.what: Stored place: navigation to #/listen/<id> to the chapter loaded and ready to play

resume.toPlaying.what: Resume from a stored place: Play pressed to playback from that place (same network)

firstAudio.readyChapter.what: First audio on an already-made chapter: Listen pressed to playing

firstAudio.newBook.what: First audio on a new book (fake Breeze: instant voice, 24 chapters of about 12 KB): Listen pressed to playing
firstAudio.newBook.note: the fake voice answers at once, so this is Bardic overhead only; a real Breeze takes about as long as the audio lasts
